info.title: Ammo Worker Lite
info.description: Design contract, not a deployed service. D1-backed authorization and monotonic writes. All .example URLs are placeholders.

get.summary: Return latest encrypted token aggregate from the pinned Mac; independent of quota sync

304.description: Unchanged; does not imply business data is fresh

404.description: No usage published, latest ciphertext expired, or unsupported on older Worker; client keeps timestamped last-good cache if present

put.summary: Replace cumulative aggregate; independent monotonic sequence and stable latest retry receipt
put.description: Requires migration0014. 256KiB envelope, 128KiB decoded ciphertext. Separate QI-USAGE|1| domain. Only latest aggregate and replay watermark retained, no ledger or cross-Mac summation. Ciphertext expires after7days; retry never renews expiry. Old Workers return404. Clients must not fail quota sync if usage upload fails.

get.summary: No secret data; protocol and push mode support only

post.summary: Initialize one workspace and writer while bootstrap is explicitly enabled

requestId.description: Optional stable bootstrap idempotency key. A matching retry returns the encrypted original credentials for ten minutes while bootstrap remains enabled; reuse with different parameters conflicts.

post.summary: Atomic pending -> claimed; no read permission until Mac approves
Approve claimed device after user confirmation

get.summary: Claim-specific capability; idempotent approved result until explicit ack
Return latest encrypted snapshot; never freshen observedAt on a cache hit

304.description: Unchanged; does not imply business data is fresh

put.summary: Monotonic source sequence; same seq + same hash is idempotent

post.summary: Explicitly rotate the pinned source key and atomically replace active viewer wraps

409.description: Epoch changed, active wraps incomplete, or rotation conflict

get.summary: Viewer retrieves only its active source-epoch HPKE wrap

recipientPublicKey.description: Viewer X25519 recipient key retained from approved pairing; null means the device must re-pair.

delete.summary: Writer may revoke paired viewer; viewer may revoke only self. User confirmation and key rotation required.
End and remove own activity registration

put.summary: Optional, consented minimal readable display fields; not full snapshot E2EE

post.summary: Claim-specific explicit ack after safe local persistence; idempotent consumed transition

get.summary: Writer inspects recipient claim before explicit approval
List writer-owned per-instance invitations and grants

post.summary: Create a ten-minute, single-claim invitation for one account instance

200.description: Invitation metadata; secret is generated only by the writer

delete.summary: Revoke one recipient and delete its projection

post.summary: Claim once with invite bearer; not yet authorized to read

get.summary: Retrieve read grant only after writer approval

200.description: Pending state or approved viewer token

post.summary: Approve displayed recipient and verification code

put.summary: Register/rotate the own device token for balance/budget alert pushes

delete.summary: Unregister the own device alert token

put.summary: Enable/disable relaying balance/budget alerts to registered iPhones (writer-controlled switch)

post.summary: Relay one balance/budget alert to consented registered iPhones

200.description: Relay outcome; deduplicated true when alertId already relayed

put.summary: Writer publishes minimal plaintext windows for the selected instance

get.summary: Read only this approved, unrevoked instance projection

deviceBearer.description: High entropy per-device token; roles and tenant bindings enforced server-side.

pairingBearer.description: Short-lived pairing proof/claim capability, never a quota write token.

shareClaimBearer.description: Claim result capability; cannot read a projection.

shareViewerBearer.description: One recipient's one-share read grant, revoked by writer.
